entities.description: A character in the play who is overtrained, emotional, and cares deeply for her share of the horse Dandy.
entities.name: GEORGIANA

entities.description: A character in the play who interacts with Georgiana and offers to swap halves of the horse Dandy.
entities.name: SIR TRISTRAM

entities.description: A horse that Georgiana and Sir Tristram co-own, with Georgiana owning the tail end and Sir Tristram the head.
entities.name: Dandy

entities.description: A character who enters in a fancy dress and is upset about no ball.
entities.name: SALOME

entities.description: A character who enters in a fancy dress and is upset about no ball.
entities.name: SHEBA

relations.description: Georgiana owns the tail end of the horse Dandy.
relations.evidence_quote: I'm like a doating mother to my share of Dandy, and it's all the dearer because it's an invalid.

relations.description: Sir Tristram owns the head of the horse Dandy.
relations.evidence_quote: Swop halves and take his head, George, my boy.

relations.description: Sir Tristram considers Georgiana an old friend, but feels he has lost the acquaintance of George Tidd and gained an introduction to Georgiana.
relations.evidence_quote: I mean that I seem to have dropped the acquaintance of George Tidd, Esquire, forever.

relations.description: Salome and Sheba enter together in fancy dresses and are both upset about no ball.
relations.evidence_quote: SALOME and SHEBA enter; both in their fancy dresses.
